name: Star Chapel — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Cross-shaped miniature plan, steep indigo roofs and clustered Gothic spires, huge purple star-rose window above pointed portal; pale stone/gold tracery, narrow flanking lancets, cypress belt and raised stair plinth. Hidden layout inference: Axial arrival stair and forecourt lead through the pointed portal to a modest ceremonial nave; transept pockets become quiet viewing alcoves, perimeter path provides loop back to water bridge without blocking entrance. Preserve dominant rose window rather than covering facade with planting. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B03-DETAIL-001 — Star Chapel — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need source-matched buttress/window wall, porch threshold/stair return and roof ridge/corner joins; source wheel, lancet, gold star and purple glass already exist. Cypress/cream flowers and small birds/butterflies selected; interior depth is proposed. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
